## Prerender.io Pricing FAQs

Find answers to common questions about Prerender.io pricing, renders, cache freshness, free trials, subscriptions, and billing so you can choose the right plan with confidence.

### What are renders? 

A render is a fully loaded version of one of your pages that we store for crawlers.

Finding the right plan is based on two key features: 1) how many renders you need and 2) how often your pages need to be refreshed.

Use our free Render Calculator to find the plan for you.

### How many renders do I need? 

This depends on your unique pages, how frequently you want them updated, and whether you want them rendered for both desktop and mobile crawlers.

Click the button that says “ Calculate My Renders“ above to give you a better idea.

### How are my renders calculated? 

Let’s take an example. Imagine you run an ecommerce store with 1,000 pages. You update your product pages daily, so you’ll want those pages re-rendered once per day to keep search engines and visitors seeing the latest information.

That’s 1,000 pages × 30 days = 30,000 renders per month.

Now, remember that each page is rendered once for desktop and once for mobile, so you’ll double that number.

30,000 × 2 = 60,000 renders per month.

### What does "cache freshness" mean? 

Cache freshness is how often your pages are re-rendered to stay up-to-date for visitors and search engines. If your site changes often (like a blog, news site, or store), you’ll want a fresher cache. If your content stays mostly the same, you can refresh less often to save on renders.

### How long is my free trial? 

You can enjoy our Starter plan for free for 30 days. After that, you can continue for $49/month.

### How does Prerender.io work? 

Prerender.io is designed to solve JavaScript SEO challenges at scale. We help crawlers from Google, ChatGPT, Reddit, and more crawl and index your content properly. That way, your content can seamlessly show up across search engines, LLMs and AI platforms, and social channels in record time.

### How does Prerender.io's pricing work? 

Our plans are renewed and charged monthly.

There are no hidden fees or complexities involved when choosing a plan. We only charge for cached tasks—the first time a page is cached or when the page has to be re-cached to pick up changes you’ve made. Because we cache your rendered pages, there’s no need to charge you for every request.

### How can I change or cancel my subscription? 

You can change or upgrade your plan via your Dashboard. Any plan changes will be active when your current billing cycle is renewed.

To cancel your subscription, simply log into your Dashboard, navigate to Subscriptions, and click on the “Cancel Subscription” button.

## Boost your visibility today

Prerender.io supercharges your visibility across AI platforms and LLMs, search engines, and social channels—all with one simple integration. Start for free today.
